anchored.name: Anchored
anchored.description: This card belongs to a fixed home location or part of Nadir and cannot come to rest elsewhere through ordinary placement.

small.name: Small
small.description: This card uses Small carried Inventory capacity.

medium.name: Medium
medium.description: This card uses Medium-compatible carried Inventory capacity.

large.name: Large
large.description: This card requires Large carried Inventory capacity.

storage-small.name: Small Storage
storage-small.description: How many Small carried cards this equipment supports while equipped.

storage-medium.name: Medium Storage
storage-medium.description: How many Small or Medium carried cards this equipment supports while equipped.

storage-large.name: Large Storage
storage-large.description: How many Small, Medium, or Large carried cards this equipment supports while equipped.

hydration.name: Hydration
hydration.description: How well hydrated Nadir is. Reaching zero is fatal.

food.name: Food
food.description: This card can be eaten through Body's generic Eat Action.

food-value.name: Food Value
food-value.description: How much Satiation this food restores.

hydration-value.name: Hydration Value
hydration-value.description: How much Hydration this source restores when consumed.

path.name: Path
path.description: This card represents a route to another Room.

travel-time.name: Travel Time
travel-time.description: The route's base travel time in minutes before Vision modifies it.

vision.name: Vision
vision.description: How well Nadir can see well enough to act. Room light and active equipment modify the effective value used for tasks, searching, and travel.

infection.name: Infection
infection.description: How infected a wound is. Lower is better.

dressed.name: Dressed
dressed.description: The wound has been covered with a sterile dressing.

sterilized.name: Sterilized
sterilized.description: This material has been sterilized and can be used where sterile fabric is required.

fabric.name: Fabric
fabric.description: This card can be used as fabric in interactions that require it.

container.name: Container
container.description: This card can hold a substance such as water.

cutting-tool.name: Cutting Tool
cutting-tool.description: This card can perform interactions that require a cutting tool.

durability.name: Durability
durability.description: How much usable life remains in the item before wear makes it unusable.

spoilage.name: Spoilage
spoilage.description: How far food or organic material has progressed toward spoiling.

powered.name: Powered
powered.description: This object currently has electrical power.

progress.name: Progress
progress.description: How far an ongoing Process has progressed toward completion.

water.name: Water
water.description: How many units of water remain in this source.
